subject.title: Feishu channel dispatch completes with replies=0 even though assistant final text is written to session transcript

question: Should Feishu recover and publish current-turn assistant final text from the session transcript when dispatch has no visible final, or should this stay blocked until the shared delivery contract defines a safer channel outcome?
rationale: Publishing transcript final text changes privacy, dedupe, and source-delivery semantics; source inspection shows the failure surface, but automation cannot safely choose the permanent fallback policy.

options.title: Keep Feishu Tracker Open
options.body: Preserve this concrete group-report evidence while maintainers gather live metadata and decide the transcript-recovery boundary.

options.title: Fold Into Delivery Contract
options.body: Close this as duplicate only if maintainers explicitly accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 as canonical for normal Feishu final text stranded in transcripts.

options.title: Promote Live Repro First
options.body: Run a credentialed Feishu proof path before any code work so the fix targets final extraction, delivery failure, or count reconciliation correctly.

recommendation.title: Keep Feishu Tracker Open
recommendation.body: Preserve this concrete group-report evidence while maintainers gather live metadata and decide the transcript-recovery boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent history across Feishu fallback behavior, shared final-delivery policy, and maintainer proof for adjacent delivery semantics.
